description: Outbound invoices (Rechnungen) including drafts, open, partially paid, paid and cancelled documents. Reads GET /Invoice; writes go through the saveInvoice factory RPC, which is the only documented create/update path for the current spec.

status.description: Filter by invoice status: 50=Draft created via the factory, 100=Draft, 200=Open, 750=Partially paid, 1000=Paid. The response model returns the same values as JSON strings.

startDate.description: Lower bound on invoiceDate (the document date, NOT the modification time): returns invoices whose invoice date is equal or higher. Declared as an integer Unix timestamp by the API contract.

endDate.description: Upper bound on invoiceDate (the document date, NOT the modification time): returns invoices whose invoice date is equal or lower. Declared as an integer Unix timestamp by the API contract.

contact[id].description: Filter by contact id (send together with contact[objectName]).

updateAfter.description: Incremental watermark: returns invoices updated last after the supplied timestamp. Grounded in the Invoice tag's filter table ('updateAfter={timestamp} | Only retrieve all invoices updated last after timestamp'), which the getInvoices operation description links to; because that table is narrative rather than a declared OpenAPI parameter, the provider documents NO unit for {timestamp}. Sent here as whole seconds since the epoch, matching the integer Unix timestamps the sibling startDate/endDate filters on the same path item declare, and matching the sevdesk order endpoint.

limit.description: Page size. The provider rejects values outside 1..1000 with HTTP 400 (enforced since 2025-05-30).

id.description: sevdesk id of the invoice; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire (system-set).

contact.description: Contact relation ({id, objectName='Contact'}); opaque relation envelope.

create.description: Creation timestamp (system-set). Wire sample carries a UTC offset ('2024-04-08T00:00:00+02:00') -> zone-aware.

update.description: Last-modification timestamp (system-set); the incremental replication cursor, pushed down via the updateAfter filter.

invoiceDate.description: Document date of the invoice; the startDate/endDate query filters window on this field. The response model omits a format declaration, but the documented sample carries a UTC offset ('2024-04-08T00:00:00+02:00') -> zone-aware.

timeToPay.description: Days until the invoice is due; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

discountTime.description: Days within which the cash discount applies; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

discount.description: Cash discount percentage; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

payDate.description: Date the invoice was paid; null while unpaid (positively evidenced by the resetToOpen/resetToDraft response examples).

createUser.description: SevUser relation that created the document ({id, objectName='SevUser'}); system-set.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date, or the start of the delivery period when deliveryDateUntil is set.

status.description: 50=Draft created via the factory, 100=Draft, 200=Open, 750=Partially paid, 1000=Paid. Serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

smallSettlement.description: Whether the client uses the small-settlement scheme. Declared boolean by the API contract, but the response example carries the quoted string '0'/'1', so the wire type is frozen as a string.

contactPerson.description: SevUser relation acting as contact person ({id, objectName='SevUser'}).

taxRate.description: Deprecated document-level tax rate - use the taxRate of the individual positions instead. Numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

taxRule.description: TaxRule relation ({id, objectName='TaxRule'}); sevdesk-Update 2.0. Declared nullable:false by the schema, but invoices created under bookkeeping system 1.0 return taxType/taxSet and no taxRule, so nulls occur in practice.

taxText.description: Tax text printed on the document (e.g. 'Umsatzsteuer 19%').

dunningLevel.description: Number of reminders already sent for the invoice; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

taxType.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 tax type; replaced by taxRule under sevdesk-Update 2.0. Enum taken verbatim from the declared schema - the field's own prose and the tag attribute table also describe a fifth value 'ss' that the declared enum does not carry (first-party inconsistency).

sendDate.description: Set by the system via sendBy/sendViaEmail.

origin.description: Relation to the object this invoice originated from, e.g. an Order ({id, objectName}). The provider folded the former originId scalar into this envelope.

invoiceType.description: RE=normal invoice, WKR=recurring invoice, SR=cancellation invoice, MA=reminder, TR=partial invoice, AR=partial final invoice, ER=final invoice.

accountIntervall.description: Interval in which recurring invoices are due, as an ISO-8601 duration. The published example '2022-03-14' is not a valid duration (first-party example bug); the value is carried through as text.

accountNextInvoice.description: Next recurring-invoice date; a Unix epoch in seconds delivered as a JSON string with no declared format, so it is kept as text rather than promoted to a temporal.

reminderTotal.description: Total reminder amount; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

reminderDebit.description: Debit of the reminder; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

reminderDeadline.description: Deadline of the reminder. Declared format: date-time; the published example '01.01.2020' is a known defective placeholder, not a wire sample.

reminderCharge.description: Additional reminder charge; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

taxSet.description: TaxSet relation (bookkeeping system version 1.0; used when taxType='custom').

address.description: Complete multiline address of the recipient including name, street, city, zip and country. The provider collapsed the former addressName/addressStreet/addressZip/addressCity scalars into this single string.

sumNet.description: Net sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumTax.description: Tax sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumGross.description: Gross sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumDiscounts.description: Sum of all discounts; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumNetForeignCurrency.description: Net sum in the foreign currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumTaxForeignCurrency.description: Tax sum in the foreign currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumGrossForeignCurrency.description: Gross sum in the foreign currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumDiscountsForeignCurrency.description: Discount sum in the foreign currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumNetAccounting.description: Net sum in the accounting currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumTaxAccounting.description: Tax sum in the accounting currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumGrossAccounting.description: Gross sum in the accounting currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

paidAmount.description: Amount already paid on the invoice. The only genuine JSON number in the response model (type: number, format: float, unquoted example).

customerInternalNote.description: Internal note on the customer, not printed on the document.

showNet.description: Whether positions are printed net. Declared boolean by the API contract, but the response example carries the quoted string '0'/'1', so the wire type is frozen as a string.

enshrined.description: Timestamp at which the invoice was enshrined (made immutable); null while the invoice is still editable.

sendType.description: VPR=printed, VPDF=downloaded, VM=mailed, VP=postal; set by the system via sendBy/sendViaEmail.

deliveryDateUntil.description: End of the delivery period when the document states a range. The response model omits a format declaration, but the documented sample carries a UTC offset ('2024-04-08T00:00:00+02:00') -> zone-aware.

datevConnectOnline.description: Internal attribute; declared as a property-less object by the provider.

sendPaymentReceivedNotificationDate.description: Internal attribute; the wire value is a plain string (e.g. '0').

schema.description: One saveInvoice payload: the invoice header plus its positions. There is no plain POST /Invoice in the current spec - the createInvoiceByFactory RPC is the only documented create path. The saveInvoice wrapper's own required list names 'invoicePos' while NO such property exists; the declared array property is 'invoicePosSave', and that is what the API accepts (first-party inconsistency). The operation description also references a 'takeDefaultAddress' parameter the request schema never declares, so it is not authored here.

invoice.description: Invoice header (Model_Invoice). Relation ids are integers on the request side, unlike the string ids the read side returns.

mapAll.description: sevdesk factory mapping flag; must be sent as true.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number (e.g. 'RE-1000'); assigned by sevdesk when omitted.

status.description: 50=Draft created via the factory, 100=Draft, 200=Open, 750=Partially paid, 1000=Paid. Status transitions after creation are driven by the action endpoints (sendBy/sendViaEmail/bookAmount, resetToOpen/resetToDraft).

address.description: Complete multiline address block printed on the document (name, street, zip, city, country).

timeToPay.description: Days until the invoice is due; integer on the request side.

discountTime.description: Days within which the cash discount applies; integer on the request side.

discount.description: Cash discount percentage; number on the request side.

deliveryDateUntil.description: End of the delivery period when the document states a range.

taxRate.description: Document-level tax rate (e.g. 19). Deprecated in favour of the per-position taxRate, but still carried by the factory.

taxSet.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; used when taxType='custom'.

taxText.description: Tax text printed on the document (e.g. 'Umsatzsteuer 19%').

taxType.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; replaced by taxRule under 2.0. Enum taken verbatim from the declared schema (the provider's prose additionally mentions 'ss').

invoiceType.description: RE=normal invoice, WKR=recurring, SR=cancellation, MA=reminder, TR=partial, AR=partial final, ER=final.

accountIntervall.description: Interval in which recurring invoices are due, as an ISO-8601 duration (WKR invoices only).

invoicePosSave.description: Positions to create with the invoice. The saveInvoice required list names 'invoicePos', but no such property exists - 'invoicePosSave' is the declared array property and the one the API accepts.

mapAll.description: sevdesk factory mapping flag; must be sent as true.

price.description: Position price; supply price or priceGross.

schema.description: One saveInvoice payload addressed at an existing document. The same factory RPC updates instead of creating when invoice.id is supplied alongside the constant envelope fields objectName='Invoice' and mapAll=true (createInvoiceByFactory: 'this request can also be used to update invoices'; InvoicePos tag update recipe). There is no PUT /Invoice/{invoiceId} in the current spec. The record carries the sevdesk id twice: once at the top level, where it is the upsert conflict key, and once inside the envelope as invoice.id, which is the field the provider actually matches on - supply the same value in both places.

id.description: sevdesk id of the invoice to update; the upsert conflict key. Numeric value, serialized as a string on the read side. Must be echoed as invoice.id, which is where the factory reads it.

invoice.description: Invoice header (Model_Invoice) carrying the id of the document to update. Relation ids are integers on the request side, unlike the string ids the read side returns. An enshrined invoice rejects modification.

id.description: sevdesk id of the invoice to update; supplying it is what turns the factory call into an update.

mapAll.description: sevdesk factory mapping flag; must be sent as true.

status.description: Status transitions are driven by the action endpoints (sendBy/sendViaEmail/bookAmount, resetToOpen/resetToDraft).

address.description: Complete multiline address block printed on the document.

taxSet.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; used when taxType='custom'.

taxType.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; replaced by taxRule under 2.0.

accountIntervall.description: Interval in which recurring invoices are due, as an ISO-8601 duration (WKR invoices only).

invoicePosSave.description: Positions sent with the update: an entry carrying its own id updates that position in place, an entry without one is added. Named 'invoicePosSave' - the saveInvoice required list's 'invoicePos' is a first-party inconsistency and matches no declared property.

id.description: sevdesk id of an existing position; omit to add a new one.

mapAll.description: sevdesk factory mapping flag; must be sent as true.
